t: Forge Steel 3-piece file set provides a comprehensive solution for shaping, deburring, and smoothing steel and other hard materials. The versatile set, containing 200mm flat, round, and half-round files, is an essential addition for fabrication workshops, metalworking projects, and general engineering tasks. Each file is constructed from high carbon steel with an oil-coated, double-sided blade, ensuring excellent durability and impact resistance for prolonged use. The ergonomic, bi-material comfort grip handles offer optimal control and reduce user fatigue, enabling precise results for professional tradespeople.
